cells.gaps: No rule held requires mobile money providers and banks to connect to each other or to a national or regional switch.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13: the central bank's December 2025 list names two e-money institutions, Telco Money SA and Hury Money SA, legally established under the 2017 e-money rules (COM-003, COM-001), so non-banks are licensed. No rule to connect is held, so not 5.
